subject: English
question_text: Put the following parts of the story in correct order to
stimulus: rewrite the whole story. 1×8=8 (a) In 1972, he was brought to Bangladesh from Kolkata and was declared our National Poet. He died on 29 August, 1976. (b) He wrote a lot of poems, songs, short stories, gazals, novels etc and travelled all branches of Bengali literature. (c) On his return from the battlefield, he gave up the sword for the pen and began to write poems. (d) In 1914, when the First World War broke out, he wanted to join the Army. At last at the age of 19, he joined the Army as an ordinary soldier. (e) His poems inspired our freedom fighters in the Liberation War in 1971. (f) At the age of 11, he showed his poetic genius. (g) His famous poem 'Bidrohi' stirred the whole nation. (h) Our national poet Kazi Nazrul Islam was born in 1306 B.S., 1899 A.D. at Churulia in the district of Burdwan. R Section B : Writing Test (Marks 50)
guide_solution: Reordering sentences (h) + (f) + (b) + (g) + (d) + (c) + (e) + (a) Section B : Writing Test
